text:
mia_sales: Quick alert - Prospect Meridian hit 429s during a POC run where they mix large embedding imports with a low-latency chat demo. Started around 09:15 PT.

mia_sales: Customer says error persists even after backoff. Theysee `HTTP 429` with `Retry-After: 5`.

oliver_se: Can you share the request pattern? Are embeddings batched very large? Any streaming enabled?

mia_sales: They upload a 50k-row CSV -> client batches 512 items per request, runs 6 parallel workers, and realtime chat runs concurrently for personalization. SDK is rdx-go 0.8.7.

jamie_runtime: Two immediate red flags: 1) batch=512 is huge for embeddings; 2) rdx-go <0.9 had a streaming accounting bug where finalization tokens posted a spike.

ravi_support: Checking tenant slice... one sec.

quota_bot: [quota-snapshot] tenant=meridian tier=poc monthly_commit=0 burst_window=60 burst_tokens=12000 current_window_consumed=11820

oliver_se: That matches — only ~180 tokens left in the burst window. A single 512-item embed can easily be >180 tokens -> immediate 429.

mia_sales: They thought monthly_commit would shield one-off imports. Can we explain quickly? Customer is asking if monthly vs burst differs.

oliver_se: Short answer: monthly_commit controls long-run billing and reserved capacity, but we still enforce a per-window burst cap to protect multi-tenant runtime. Big single requests can exceed the burst even if the monthly balance is fine.

jamie_runtime: Pasted trimmed proxy log (ms epoch):
```
[1867890162.010] tenant=meridian route=/v1/embeddings tokens=1520 bucket_before=2000 bucket_after=480
[1867890162.224] tenant=meridian route=/v1/embeddings tokens=1600 bucket_before=480 bucket_after=-1120 throttle=1 -> 429
[1867890163.501] tenant=meridian route=/v1/chat tokens=40 bucket_before=-1120 bucket_after=-1160 throttle=1 -> 429
```

ravi_support: The negative bucket shows burst exhausted mid-import. Two quick mitigations for the demo: (A) reduce embed batch size to <=64 and limit workers to 4, (B) request a short-lived burst reservation so the import finishes.

mia_sales: Which is fastest for the customer to act on? Theyprefer not to change code if possible.

jamie_runtime: Fastest = temporary reservation by infra. Client changes take longer. But we should still recommend a long-term fix.

oliver_se: I'll provision a 3h reservation: id=resv-20260321-9001 amount=10000 scope=burst ttl=10800. Need billing ok.

billing_bot: [billing-check] tenant=meridian credit_ok=true available_override_tokens=15000 monthly_commit_margin=NA

mia_sales: Approve 3h reservation. Please annotate deal notes and revert after.

quota_bot: [reservation-applied] tenant=meridian id=resv-20260321-9001 applied_by=oliver_se expires=186789 *placeholder*

jamie_runtime: Note: make sure reservation is reflected in the proxy's aggregated remaining header. Otherwise client still sees remaining=0 and will backoff unnecessarily.

ravi_support: While override applied, advise customer to run with concurrency throttled: workers=4 batch=64 and add exponential backoff with jitter for 429s.

mia_sales: They asked about pricing: will the reservation cause extra charges?

billing_bot: Reservation is a temporary capacity bump. Overages beyond monthly_commit are billed per policy. We'll follow standard POC billing: short-lived overrides for presales are not billed if used for demo; record to internal billing notes.

oliver_se: Follow-ups: 1) Add a presales runbook line: "Large embed imports: recommend client-side splitting + presales reservation option" 2) RFC to surface aggregated tenant remaining in API header `X-RDX-Aggregate-Remaining` so clients can make deterministic backoff decisions. 3) SDK sweep: ensure rdx-go has streaming finalization accounting fixed in 0.9.0.

jamie_runtime: I'll file runtime ticket RUNTIME-2241 (aggregate header) and SDK ticket SDK-1129 (streaming accounting).

mia_sales: Customer completed import after reservation. They will update embed pipeline to chunk smaller batches. They want a short checklist we can attach to the deal.

ravi_support: I'll draft the checklist: minimal items (SDK >=0.9.0, embed batch <=64, max parallel workers <=4, backoff+w jitter, request reservation for large one-offs). Will post link.

mia_sales: Great. Please add note in CRM and mark POC green. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
